after_taxonomy.classification_basis: December 2025 AWS Cost Explorer disruption is documented, but the AI-agent contribution is affirmatively contested. The Financial Times attributed a roughly 13-hour interruption and an environment deletion/recreation decision to Kiro under engineering permissions, whereas Amazon acknowledged a limited one-region Cost Explorer interruption and attributed it to human error and a misconfigured access role. The discrepancy extends to duration and the number of related events. Source control of internal actions does not make Amazon's denial automatically exculpatory; equally, a press attribution cannot establish the precise agent-caused action without the decision path. The distinction between observed outage, reported tool involvement and verified causal mechanism remains an explicit current-edition Boundary.
